options.text: One vertical asymptote and one horizontal asymptote

questions.explanation: The graph of $y = \frac{1}{x}$ has a vertical asymptote at $x = 0$ (the $y$-axis) and a horizontal asymptote at $y = 0$ (the $x$-axis).

questions.stem: For the function $y = \frac{1}{x}$, what happens as $x$ gets very large?
questions.explanation: As $x \to \infty$, $\frac{1}{x} \to 0$. The $y$-values get closer and closer to $0$ but never reach it.
